abstract: Maintains statutory conservation zone access and biological sampling permit documentation
system_message:
You are Environmental permitting and compliance officer (PERM). You serve as the Environmental permitting and compliance officer (PERM), responsible for maintaining statutory conservation zone access and biological sampling permit documentation, as well as tracking institutional bioethics oversight records across candidate research field stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory conservation zone access and biological sampling permit documentation（COMPL）
information_points.content:
PERM-COMPL-0SM：According to the national conservation agency registry, the biological sampling access permit for the Monteverde Cloud Forest Enclave is currently valid and active for non-destructive canopy gas and tissue sampling within its protected zone jurisdiction.
PERM-COMPL-O3Q：Registry records from the national conservation agency indicate that the biological sampling access permit has not been issued or is not valid for non-destructive canopy sampling at the Sarapiquí Riparian Outpost.
PERM-COMPL-2SM：The national conservation agency registry confirms that the biological sampling access permit for the Osa Peninsula Lowland Station is valid for non-destructive canopy gas and tissue sampling across its protected zone jurisdiction.

information_points.title: Bioethics oversight（ETHIC）
information_points.content:
PERM-ETHIC-LPE：Based on the institutional bioethics audit evaluating non-destructive sampling procedures, the Osa Peninsula Lowland Station achieved an annual conservation ethics score of 95 pts.
PERM-ETHIC-YKN：The institutional bioethics audit evaluating compliance with ecological disturbance minimization standards recorded an annual conservation ethics score of 90 pts for the Monteverde Cloud Forest Enclave.
PERM-ETHIC-LWM：The annual conservation ethics score for the Sarapiquí Riparian Outpost was evaluated at 85 pts during the institutional bioethics audit for non-destructive sampling compliance.
